name: Detecting Signs Of Depression In Text
description: Affective computing research module analyzing linguistic indicators, self-referential pronoun density, and depressive sentiment markers.
limitations: Humor, coping mechanisms, and contextual nuance cannot be adequately judged by automated NLP parsers.
responsible_use_notes: CRITICAL HEALTHCARE WARNING: THIS IS NOT A DIAGNOSTIC TOOL. Under no circumstances infer or label a real individual's clinical mental health from their writings.
